about: Lisanne Leasure is an attorney providing legal services covering Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Defense, General Litigation, Administrative Law and Employment Litigation: Defense.

Lisanne Leasure, who practices law in Denver, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of Maine School of Law. She graduated in 1999. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1999.
